hook:
There is only one.

Jeep dropped a 6.4-litre V8 into a Wrangler and left every off-road part in place.
body:
Full-time four-wheel drive, electronic sway-bar disconnect, and lockers front and rear. The quickest Wrangler ever built is also still a Wrangler.

2024 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392 — 470 hp · 470 lb-ft · 0–60 mph in 4.5 sec.

· 470 hp and 470 lb-ft — an unusually square power and torque figure — under a removable roof.
· 4.5 seconds to 60 mph, in a vehicle with a live axle at each end.
· Sway-bar disconnect and lockers front and rear survive the V8 intact.
· 32.5 inches of fording depth and 10.3 inches of clearance: the trail hardware was never traded away for the engine.

The result is the quickest Wrangler built, with its off-road specification unchanged.
cta: Last of the V8 Wranglers, or the one they should have started with?
